metadata.question: Acquire current California wildfire data for assessing smoke impact on the Los Angeles basin. Tasks: (1) Retrieve active fire perimeters from a live source (NIFC/USFS/CAL FIRE feature service or equivalent); (2) Derive the smoke-impacted region downwind of fires affecting the LA basin (approximate bbox: lat 33.5–34.5, lon -119.0 to -117.5); (3) Gather smoke forecast data (e.g. AirNow, NOAA HRRR-smoke, or BlueSky) over the region; (4) Collect air-quality monitor readings (PM2.5/AQI) for stations in or near the LA basin. Return typed acquisition state including fire names, acreages, containment, smoke footprint, and monitor readings.
